 Danube unveils premium waterfront project in Dubai Maritime City 
 DUBAI 
 Thu, 12 Nov 2026 
 SHARE
 UAE-based Danube Properties has announced the launch of its fully furnished waterfront development - Shahrukhz Residences by Danube - in Dubai Maritime City, featuring 1,126 residential units with a mix of one- to three-bedroom apartments, signature ocean residences and luxury penthouses.
 The tower will feature 40+ lifestyle amenities, including a first-of-its-kind Longevity Lounge with cryotherapy, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, a red-light therapy bed, infrared sauna and other longevity-inspired facilities. 
 Residents will also enjoy aqua-themed play areas, sports facilities, children's daycare, cycling and jogging tracks, an exclusive rooftop King's Club and access to a private yacht.
 The premium project was unveiled at a key event held yesterday (November 11) at Coca-Cola Arena, Dubai, in presence of the Danube Group Founder and Chairman Rizwan Sajan, Bollywod actor Shah Rukh Khan and his wife Gauri Khan.
 Hosted by filmmaker Karan Johar, the event marked the second collaboration between Rizwan Sajan and SRK. A highlight of the evening was the announcement that all Gauri Khan-designed penthouses, each valued at $5.35 million, had sold out on launch day. 
 Expressing gratitude for the phenomenal response, Sajan said: “Shahrukhz Residences is more than a development; it represents our ambition to create homes that bring together exceptional design, meaningful experiences and lasting value. The response, particularly the penthouse sell-out, is a proud milestone for our team.”
 On the new launch, Shah Rukh Khan said: “It’s wonderful to see the Shahrukhz journey evolve from a successful commercial landmark into an iconic residential address. The idea of living life king style is brought to life through experiences envisioned for this development.”
 As part of a launch offer, apartments at Shahrukhz Residences are priced from $450,000, with a 30:70 payment plan requiring buyers to pay 30% during construction and the remaining 70% upon handover.
 On the luxury penthouses, Gauri said: “I wanted to create spaces that feel elegant, warm and distinctive, while making the most of the waterfront setting. It’s special to see this design vision receive such an encouraging response, with a houseful mark already stamped on it.”
 A freehold property, it is strategically located between Port Rashid and Dubai Dry Docks, thus adding to its appeal for buyers exploring waterfront property in Dubai, said Danube in its statement. 
 Shahrukhz Residences by Danube follows the success of the Shahrukhz commercial tower, which was sold out on launch day in 2025, it added.- TradeArabia News Service
